author: birdybro (GitHub; MiSTer contributor)
what_it_is: birdybro's own MiSTer MegaCD save for Shining Force CD (alternate USA pressing), written with 'Backup RAM: Internal+Cart' on; zip entry dated 2021-02-26 18:41.
note: Extracted unchanged from saves.zip (sha1 9ced6d6c8b2047fe8225aaf37201e15095da3ace, 2602364 bytes), entry MegaCD/Shining Force CD (USA) (5R, 6R).sav; the zip is birdybro's whole MiSTer saves/ folder, posted 2022-03-02 ('here's just a big zip of all my saves on my MiSTer'). Core attribution is by the folder: MiSTer Main writes MegaCD core saves to saves/MegaCD/<cue or chd stem>.sav (support/megacd/megacd.cpp mcd_mount_save). Directory name is the uploader's disc name, which matches the Redump-style set names. 532480 bytes = 8 KiB internal BRAM (sectors 0x00-0x0F) + 512 KiB RAM cart (sectors 0x10-0x40F), as MegaCD.sv writes when status[3] (CART_EN, RAM_ID 6 = 512 KiB) is set. Internal part: footer at 0x1FC0 ('___________', SEGA_CD_ROM at 0x1FE0, RAM_CARTRIDGE___ at 0x1FF0), 24 free blocks, 2 files. Cart part: formatted but empty (footer at 0x81FC0..0x81FFF, 0x1FFD = 8189 free blocks, 0 files; the only 48 non-zero bytes of the cart half are that footer). The cart's last 512-byte sector equals Main_MiSTer's ext_blank template (support/megacd/megacd.cpp mcd_fill_blanksave, served for LBA 0x40F when the file is shorter), so the cart was probably never formatted by a game, only blank-filled by Main. Plain byte order, not byte-doubled. birdybro's zip also has 'Shining Force CD (USA) (3R).sav' (532480, 2022-02-09) whose cart half is all zeros with no footer; not filed here.
